using namespace std;

// --- FastReader implementation (similar to Java) ---
class FastReader {
private:
    string line;
    istringstream iss;
public:
    FastReader() {}
    string next() {
        while (iss.fail() || iss.eof()) {
            if (!getline(cin, line)) break;
            iss.clear();
            iss.str(line);
        }
        string token;
        iss >> token;
        return token;
    }
    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(next());
    }
    long long nextLong() {
        return stoll(next());
    }
    double nextDouble() {
        return stod(next());
    }
    string nextLine() {
        string str;
        getline(cin, str);
        return str;
    }
};

// --- Unused but defined for completeness ---
struct Node {
    long long pp, a, b;
    Node(long long x, long long y) : a(x), b(y), pp(a * b) {}
};

struct Comp {
    bool operator()(const Node& o1, const Node& o2) const {
        return o1.pp < o2.pp;
    }
};

// --- Utility functions ---
int gcd(int x, int y) {
    if (y == 0) return x;
    return gcd(y, x % y);
}

long long mod_pow(long long a, long long b, long long mod) {
    a %= mod;
    if (b == 0) return 1 % mod;
    if (b & 1) return a * mod_pow(a, b - 1, mod) % mod;
    else {
        long long u = mod_pow(a, b >> 1, mod);
        return (u * u) % mod;
    }
}

long long _pow(long long a, long long b) {
    if (b == 0) return 1;
    if (b & 1) return a * _pow(a, b - 1);
    else {
        long long u = _pow(a, b >> 1);
        return u * u;
    }
}

int modInv(int a, int m) {
    if (gcd(a, m) != 1) return -999;
    else return (a % m + m) % m;
}

bool isPowerOfTwo(int x) {
    return x != 0 && ((x & (x - 1)) == 0);
}

bool isprime(int x) {
    if (x < 2) return false;
    for (int i = 2; i <= sqrt(x); i++) {
        if (x % i == 0) return false;
    }
    return true;
}

const int MAXV = 1000007;
bool prime[MAXV];

void sieve() {
    fill(prime, prime + MAXV, true);
    prime[0] = prime[1] = false;
    for (int i = 2; i <= sqrt(MAXV); i++) {
        if (prime[i]) {
            for (int j = i * 2; j < MAXV; j += i)
                prime[j] = false;
        }
    }
}

struct Pair {
    int ff, ss;
    Pair(int ff, int ss) : ff(ff), ss(ss) {}
};

// --- Main ---
int main() {
    FastReader sc;
    int n = sc.nextInt(), w = sc.nextInt();
    vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] = sc.nextInt();

    int e = 0, o = 0;
    deque<int> stack;
    stack.push_front(a[0]); // unused, but kept for fidelity

    vector<int> cuts;
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
        if ((a[i] & 1) == 0) ++e;
        else ++o;
        if (e == o) cuts.push_back(abs(a[i] - a[i + 1]));
    }

    n = cuts.size();
    vector<vector<int>> dp(n + 1, vector<int>(w + 1, 0));

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= w; j++) {
            if (cuts[i - 1] <= j) {
                dp[i][j] = max(1 + dp[i - 1][j - cuts[i - 1]], dp[i - 1][j]);
            } else {
                dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j];
            }
        }
    }

    int ans = dp[n][w];
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}
